tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The ground: canvas, sidebar, lesson column and demo chrome. Also the text colour on an accent fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: First raised step: the prompt bar shell, cards, the user turn, the demo frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised-2
tokens.usage: Second raised step: menus, popovers, hover and selected rows, quiet buttons, disabled primary actions.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn role for cards; the same step as surface-raised.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn role; the same step as surface-raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn role; the same step as surface-raised.

tokens.name: message-surface
tokens.usage: Background of a user turn in the transcript.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers (model picker, usage detail).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn's hover and selection surface. It is a surface, not the brand accent: the amber is primary.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary ink: prose, titles, values. 16.7:1 on background, 15.5:1 on surface-raised, 14.3:1 on surface-raised-2. Light: 16.7:1 on background, 15.4:1 on surface-raised, 14.0:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: labels, secondary copy, toolbar triggers, unselected choices. 9.3:1 on background, 8.6:1 on surface-raised, 8.0:1 on surface-raised-2. Light: 8.7:1 on background, 8.0:1 on surface-raised, 7.3:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Tertiary ink: timestamps, hints, meta. The faintest text allowed: 5.6:1 on background, 5.1:1 on surface-raised, 4.8:1 on surface-raised-2. Light: 5.8:1 on background, 5.4:1 on surface-raised, 4.9:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The amber accent, reserved for the learner's turn (turn label, waiting dots), the primary action, the selected choice and keyboard focus. Never for links or decoration. 9.4:1 on background, 8.8:1 on surface-raised. Light: a deeper amber so it still reads as text: 5.9:1 on background, 5.5:1 on surface-raised, 5.0:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. 9.4:1 on primary. Light: white on the deeper amber, 6.3:1.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: The 14% amber tint behind the Your turn label (the app mixes it with color-mix over surface-raised). primary reads at 6.8:1 on it. Light: primary reads at 5.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 1px on controls, 2px on demo buttons. 8.8:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for table rules and quiet dividers only. Never a structural separator between panes.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edge of choices, inputs and the context ring track.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; always paired with words. 8.1:1 on background. Light: 5.7:1 on background, 4.8:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct verdicts and finished states; always paired with a word or mark. 9.6:1 on background. Light: 5.4:1 on background, 4.6:1 on surface-raised-2.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings share the amber; pair them with words so they never read as your turn.

color.note: Dark is the app's theme and the first theme. Light is a design-system addition (2026-10-28): the app ships dark only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Lesson h1 and page titles. Newsreader, capped at 600.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: h3 and below, section headings in settings and the demo workspace.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Gradient descent reduces loss by adjusting the weights.
styles.usage: Lesson prose, questions and every answer field. Follows the reading-size preference.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Interface text: buttons, choices, sidebar rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Turn kind and toolbar triggers. Off the ladder in the source; kept exact.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Field labels, timestamps, running heads. The UI floor.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code and numeric metadata only; the one place 12px is allowed.

spacing.note: A 4px rhythm: every padding, margin and gap is a whole multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Toolbar padding; gap inside a choice list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label top padding; gap between a choice's mark and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Prompt bar side inset; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between transcript blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a running head.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, choices, triggers, the turn label.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the prompt bar shell, the user turn, the demo frame, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the round chat send, status dots and avatars.
